preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2 * 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each number a_i on the vertices is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The length of the list a is equal to the number of vertices n.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) and isinstance(count, int) and 1 <= i <= 2 * 10**5 and count >= 0 for i, count in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains an integer i between 1 and 200,000 and a non-negative integer count.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for x in range(1, n + 1) for y in range(x, n + 1) if gcd(a[x - 1], a[y - 1], *path_gcds(x, y)) == i) for i, count in output)
postconditions.description: The count for each integer i is the number of pairs (x, y) such that the GCD of the numbers on the path from x to y is i.
